author: timwork_notes
text: terraform-mcp-server with MCP_SESSION_MODE=stateless reused the first caller's token for every user after them... CVE-2026-16498, cvss 10. no session id in stateless mode, so a cache keyed on session id sees one tenant.

author: phantmradar
text: Palo Alto now says PHP2Shell is being actively exploited against PAN-OS management interfaces exposed to the internet. Advisory raised to Critical today. 11 hotfix builds are out, rest due by Oct 30. Until then, pull that interface off the internet.

author: cubillas888
text: Supply chain attack postmortem from LiteLLM: it says a master key committed to a public repo on May 27 was never revoked. An org owner's unscoped GitHub token, taken Oct 10, then led to malicious 1.107.0 on Oct 21. Lesson: force-pushing over a commit isn't revoking a key.

author: Gurucul
text: The LiteLLM 1.107.0 supply chain attack deployed an infostealer targeting cloud credentials, AI API keys, SSH keys, and developer secrets through malicious Python startup files.

author: morphisec
text: Storm-0940 (China) Used ARTEX Agentic AI to Weaponize ConnectWise Supply Chain Attack - 2,900 Sign-In Failures Per Minute. Microsoft formally attributed the ConnectWise Cloud Backup attack.

author: DarkWebInformer
text: Veeam patches critical Backup & Replication authorization bypass. Veeam has released security updates addressing five vulnerabilities across Backup & Replication, Veeam Agent for Linux and Veeam ONE. The most serious, CVE-2026-108142, carries a CVSS score of 9.1

author: Python_s_
text: Critical CVE-2026-40281 thecodingmachine / gotenberg: VulnCheck reports real-world exploitation activity. Public PoC/exploit available; Active exploitation reported.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: Two critical unauthenticated RCE flaws in PHP's core engine (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619) affect every PHP install serving web requests. Public PoCs are circulating and Bishop Fox confirmed RCE in their lab with ASLR enabled.

author: EmunaEliran
text: Hitachi JP1/Automatic Job Management System 3: 8 critical CVEs published today, up to CVSS 9.8, all network-reachable with no privileges or user interaction. CVE-2026-76938 (CVSS 9.8): authentication bypass in the Manager; CVE-2026-76934

author: D0xedDevi0
text: PHP2Shell: tens of thousands of tries 45 min post-disclosure, millions by Oct 22, Mirai in the payloads. Then PHP flagged CVE-2026-115560, a second unpatched RCE.

author: Daily_CyberSec
text: Patch 5 Veeam vulnerabilities in Veeam Backup & Replication and Veeam ONE, including critical flaw CVE-2026-108142 and MFA bypass CVE-2026-107671.

author: TechDeckNews
text: A 16-year-old bug in server firmware just got a 9.5/10 critical rating, and it hits most servers on Earth. The bug is in EDK II, the open-source UEFI code almost every server uses.

author: TheHackerWire
text: CVE-2026-65145 (CVSS 10.0 Critical): Missing authentication in NVIDIA NeMo Agent Toolkit allows unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary code across AI pipelines. Update NeMo Agent Toolkit to >= v1.8.1.

author: SecWeekly
text: A newly reported indirect prompt injection attack uses a malicious agents.md file to influence AI agents, potentially changing their configuration and enabling further malicious activity.

author: aviatrixtrc
text: 44 AI agents. Zero human oversight. CyberStrikeAI executed the full attack lifecycle, recon to ransomware, against 19+ organizations in under 24 hours. Agents harvested credentials, pivoted across Kubernetes environments, hijacked cloud inference endpoints.

author: aviatrixtrc
text: Researchers observed a CoreGraphics zero-day (CVE-2025-43564) exploited in highly targeted attacks against older iOS devices: arbitrary code execution triggered by processing a maliciously crafted file.

author: SecureChap
text: GMO Onamae Desktop Cloud intrusion on 20 October left MT4/MT5 credentials on up to 26,739 servers exposed after malware landed. No ransomware executed on any machine.

author: micknos8
text: RMS Cloud (booking software used by many holiday parks) is investigating a breach. Guests are receiving fake emails, texts and WhatsApp messages with real booking details asking for payment information.

author: cubillas888
text: Infostealer alert for developers: Check Point says Aokigahara also collects session and config files from AI tools like Claude, Codex and Cursor, plus Git, SSH and cloud credentials. Infected? Revoke AI sessions and rotate keys from a clean device.

author: CHCHNews
text: Canada's privacy watchdog has launched an investigation into a reportedly massive Crime Stoppers data breach as police departments across the country have paused accepting tips through the platform.

author: Orlon21
text: Potential security concerns have been raised about Reverse Engineer Anything (REA). text:
Alarm bells ratcheted up yet again about an AI-discovered vulnerability that could — if exploited in the wild — destabilize vast stretches of the internet.

author: theagenticdaily
text: NVIDIA open-sourced SkillSpector, a scanner that checks AI agent skills for malicious code before you install them on Claude Code, Codex, or MCP. In a research scan of 31,132 public agent skills, 26.1% had at least one vulnerability and 5.2% were likely malicious. https://t.co/ZNAPLJa78H

author: WorldCyberNewsX
text:
Positive Technologies flags two actively exploited flaws: CVE-2026-85880 in Windows ALPC used by TA412 and other clusters in BlueMoon chains, and critical CVE-2026-85102 in Check Point Security Gateway VPN negotiation.

Both added to @CISAgov KEV; public PoC exists for the Check

text:

author: so_sthbryan
text:
CISA just added two critical flaws to its actively exploited list.

The KEV catalog update with CVSS 9.2 bugs:
- CVE-2026-110447 in Collabora Online CODE Server at CVSS 9.2
- Critical Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator remote code execution
- Both are actively exploited in the wild

author: defango
text:
PHP2Shell, in plain English: who's exposed, and the 2-minute check. 🧵

Two critical PHP bugs (CVE-2026-109618 / -109619, CVSS 9.2) let attackers run code on your server without logging in. As of yesterday, CISA lists them as actively exploited. https://t.co/jXABs82rk8

author: infrastack_ai
text:
🛡️ Akamai and Cloudflare WAFs block known StyleSmuggler exploits. You still need to patch.

The flaw: CVE-2026-75650, a template engine injection in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, lets attackers run code on the store server. CVSS 10.0.

Actively exploited and listed in https://t.co/fF34viHaGW

author: teddyaisi
text: Adding a remote MCP server is a trust decision. Pillar Security found remote code execution in opencode on Windows/WSL via MCP OAuth. A crafted authorization_endpoint ran as PowerShell. Fixed in 1.18.33, no advisory or CVE.

author: Lhmisme
text: Three MCP implementations patched the same auth hole, and all three advisories say upgrading alone doesn't close it: a client fetches the authorization server's metadata and never checks that the issuer in the document matches where it was fetched from.

author: AiRiskBytes
text: Your coding agent trusts any instruction file it finds in its working directory. A security firm found a malicious AGENTS.md file in a customer's Downloads folder; the AI coding agent read it as instructions and tried to install a malicious npm package.

author: verbal72
text: The LiteLLM hack didn't start with malware. It started with an agent's config: LiteLLM's experimental cloud-agent platform used an unscoped personal GitHub token of an org owner, which was stolen and used to hijack the release pipeline.

author: jbhall56
text: LiteLLM has traced last week's supply chain attack to a master key it accidentally committed to a public GitHub repository in May.

author: maverickintech
text: The Railway security breach: according to Railway's preliminary incident report, attackers were searching for AI provider API keys. Rotate your secrets.

author: neo_logos_
text: Genesys said on Oct. 19 that hackers accessed internal business systems and likely downloaded customer-relationship data; it says its cloud platforms were not compromised. A group called ScarlettGroup claimed the attack.

author: security_score
text: Two TeamPCP suspects have been arrested for their alleged roles in a supply chain campaign, but their attack blueprint lives on. SecurityScorecard STRIKE research on the worm.

author: 2Workly
text: Apple backported fixes for actively exploited CoreGraphics flaw CVE-2026-86950 to iOS 18.7.11. MDM teams must enforce updates on legacy fleets.
